notes.title: Major update 3.0.0 ADV mode has been implemented.
notes.content: [list][*][p]ADV mode is implemented for those who do not need the story or RPG parts and just want to learn Go.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed other minor bugs and added additional information.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634745/6a9072dc0d6673ff799ebe69cd2dc42e99cec866.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634745/7a85baac0d86b37d73155f04c836d3f9a6ea7ead.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update 2.2.0: Standardized the turn for the problematic moves to Black.
notes.content:
* Standardized the turn for all problems to Black
* Added variations to problems up to the point where stones are captured, as much as possible
* Added supplementary explanations for some parts
